name: broadcast-unnichat
description: Broadcast multi-tenant — React + Vite (/web) e Firebase Cloud Functions (/functions)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/with-jdk.mjs firebase emulators:start --project demo-broadcast
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/with-jdk.mjs firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-broadcast "vitest run"
scripts.test:functions: node scripts/with-jdk.mjs firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-broadcast "npm --prefix functions test"
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix functions run lint
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tests && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.format: prettier --write web functions tests scripts README.md firebase.json firestore.indexes.json package.json lint-staged.config.mjs vitest.config.ts .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check web functions tests scripts README.md firebase.json firestore.indexes.json package.json lint-staged.config.mjs vitest.config.ts .github
